message:
The other day, we had a little scare when the weather turned unexpectedly stormy. My kids were buzzing in the family group chat, sharing updates and asking if we had everything ready. It made me realize how important it is to have our go-bags packed and all our documents in one place. We might not need them often, but knowing they're ready gives us all a sense of calm. 

I chuckled at one point when my grandson suggested we throw in snacks, because, of course, what’s an emergency without a few treats? It reminded me that preparedness doesn’t have to be all serious—sometimes, it’s about being ready while keeping our spirits up too.
